prompt:
Users want to duplicate an episode, to try another take without losing the original.
- Add `POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/duplicate`, returning the new episode. The copy goes after the project's other episodes, its title marks it as a copy, and it keeps the summary and the same cuts in the same order, with their scripts, dialogues, layouts, characters and images. Changing or deleting either episode afterwards never affects the other. Duplicating is free. Only members of the episode's workspace may duplicate it; to anyone else the episode does not exist (404).
- On the project's Episodes page, every episode gets a Duplicate action next to Delete, and the copy shows up in the list without a reload. Both languages.
Add tests.

Work on your own; nobody will answer questions. When you finish, report: status `done` if you did the task, `not_found` if something the task names does not exist, `blocked` if you could not do it; `answer` holds any answer the task asks for (otherwise one short sentence); `changed` lists the files you changed.
follow_ups:
Change of plan for the order: a copy goes right after its original, and the episodes after it move down one place. Deleting an episode closes the gap. A project's episodes are always numbered 1, 2, 3… with no gaps or repeats, and the list API returns them in that order.
Keep the tests up to date.

Users delete episodes by mistake. Add `POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/restore`: a deleted episode comes back with its cuts at the place it had, and the episodes from there on move down one place. Only members of its workspace may restore it; to anyone else it does not exist (404).
On the Episodes page, the message shown after a delete offers Undo, which restores the episode. Both languages. Add tests.

report.answer: Added POST /api/v1/episodes/{id}/restore: it brings a deleted episode back with its cuts at its old place and shifts later episodes down one. Non-members and unknown ids get 404. The Episodes page's delete message now has an Undo button in en and ko. The backend suite (13 tests, 4 new) and tsc pass.

+        not episode
+        or episode.deleted_at is not None
+        or not project
+        or project.deleted_at is not None

+    renumber_episodes(session, episode.project_id)
+    session.flush()

+    for later in session.exec(
+        select(Episode)
+        .where(Episode.project_id == episode.project_id)
+        .where(Episode.deleted_at == None)
+        .where(Episode.episode_order > episode.episode_order)
+    ).all():
+        later.episode_order += 1
+        session.add(later)
+
+    new_episode = Episode(

+        story_summary=episode.story_summary,

+                    filename=asset.filename,
+                    file_url=asset.file_url,
+                    file_type=asset.file_type,
+                )
+                session.add(new_asset)
+                session.flush()
+                asset_id = new_asset.id
+        status = cut.status
+        if status == "generating":
+            status = "completed" if cut.image_path else "idle"
+        session.add(StoryCut(
+            episode_id=new_episode.id,
+            cut_order=cut.cut_order,
+            script=cut.script,
+            location=cut.location,
+            time_of_day=cut.time_of_day,

+    episode_id: UUID,
+    current_user_id: str = Depends(deps.get_current_user_id),
+) -> Any:
+    """
+    Restore a deleted episode (with its cuts) to the place it had.
+    """
+    episode = session.get(Episode, episode_id)
+    project = session.get(Project, episode.project_id) if episode else None
+    if (
+        not episode
+        or not project
+        or project.deleted_at is not None
+        or not session.get(WorkspaceMember, (project.workspace_id, UUID(current_user_id)))
+    ):
+        raise AppException(error_code=ErrorCode.NOT_FOUND_EPISODE)
+
+    if episode.deleted_at is None:
+        return episode  # already live: nothing to do
+
+    live = session.exec(
+        select(Episode)
+        .where(Episode.project_id == episode.project_id)
+        .where(Episode.deleted_at == None)
+    ).all()
+    position = min(max(episode.episode_order, 1), len(live) + 1)
+    for other in live:
+        if other.episode_order >= position:
+            other.episode_order += 1
+            session.add(other)
+    episode.episode_order = position
+    episode.deleted_at = None
+    session.add(episode)
+    session.flush()
+    renumber_episodes(session, episode.project_id)
+    session.commit()
+    session.refresh(episode)
+    return episode

+from sqlmodel import Session, select
+
+from tests.conftest import signup
+
+
+def _setup(client, h):
+    pid = client.post("/api/v1/projects", headers=h, json={"title": "P", "genres": []}).json()["id"]
+    ep = client.post("/api/v1/episodes", headers=h, json={
+        "title": "Pilot", "project_id": pid, "episode_order": 1, "story_summary": "sum"}).json()
+    return pid, ep
+
+
+def _add_cuts(ep_id):
+    from app.db.engine import engine
+    from app.models import StoryCut
+    with Session(engine) as s:
+        for i in (2, 1):
+            s.add(StoryCut(episode_id=ep_id, cut_order=i, script=f"s{i}", selected_layout="full",
+                           aspect_ratio="1:1", image_path=f"img/{i}.png",
+                           dialogues=[{"speaker": "A", "text": f"t{i}"}],
+                           appearing_characters=[{"id": "x", "name": "A"}]))
+        s.commit()
+
+
+def _cuts(ep_id):
+    from app.db.engine import engine
+    from app.models import StoryCut
+    with Session(engine) as s:
+        return [c.model_dump() for c in s.exec(
+            select(StoryCut).where(StoryCut.episode_id == ep_id).order_by(StoryCut.cut_order)).all()]
+
+
+def test_duplicate_copies_episode_and_cuts(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid, ep = _setup(client, h)
+    _add_cuts(ep["id"])
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep['id']}/duplicate", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    new = r.json()
+    assert new["id"] != ep["id"]
+    assert new["project_id"] == pid
+    assert new["episode_order"] == 2
+    assert new["title"] != "Pilot" and "Pilot" in new["title"]
+    assert new["story_summary"] == "sum"
+    a, b = _cuts(ep["id"]), _cuts(new["id"])
+    keys = ["cut_order", "script", "selected_layout", "aspect_ratio", "image_path", "dialogues", "appearing_characters"]
+    assert [[c[k] for k in keys] for c in a] == [[c[k] for k in keys] for c in b]
+    assert [c["cut_order"] for c in b] == [1, 2]
+    assert {c["id"] for c in a}.isdisjoint({c["id"] for c in b})
+    listed = client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={pid}", headers=h).json()
+    assert [e["title"] for e in listed][0] == "Pilot" and len(listed) == 2
+
+
+def test_duplicate_is_independent_and_free(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid, ep = _setup(client, h)
+    _add_cuts(ep["id"])
+    before = client.get("/api/v1/workspaces", headers=h).json()[0]["credits"]
+    new = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep['id']}/duplicate", headers=h).json()
+    assert client.get("/api/v1/workspaces", headers=h).json()[0]["credits"] == before
+    client.put(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep['id']}", headers=h, json={"title": "Changed"})
+    assert client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes/{new['id']}", headers=h).json()["title"] == new["title"]
+    assert client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep['id']}", headers=h).status_code == 204
+    assert client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes/{new['id']}", headers=h).status_code == 200
+    assert len(_cuts(new["id"])) == 2
+
+
+def _orders(client, h, pid):
+    return [(e["title"], e["episode_order"]) for e in client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes?project_id={pid}", headers=h).json()]
+
+
+def test_duplicate_goes_right_after_original_and_shifts_others(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid, ep = _setup(client, h)
+    client.post("/api/v1/episodes", headers=h, json={"title": "Two", "project_id": pid, "episode_order": 2})
+    client.post("/api/v1/episodes", headers=h, json={"title": "Three", "project_id": pid, "episode_order": 3})
+    new = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep['id']}/duplicate", headers=h).json()
+    assert new["episode_order"] == 2
+    assert _orders(client, h, pid) == [("Pilot", 1), (new["title"], 2), ("Two", 3), ("Three", 4)]
+
+
+def test_delete_closes_the_gap(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid, ep = _setup(client, h)
+    two = client.post("/api/v1/episodes", headers=h, json={"title": "Two", "project_id": pid, "episode_order": 2}).json()
+    client.post("/api/v1/episodes", headers=h, json={"title": "Three", "project_id": pid, "episode_order": 3})
+    assert client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{two['id']}", headers=h).status_code == 204
+    assert _orders(client, h, pid) == [("Pilot", 1), ("Three", 2)]
+    assert client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep['id']}", headers=h).status_code == 204
+    assert _orders(client, h, pid) == [("Three", 1)]
+
+
+def test_create_keeps_numbering_contiguous(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid, _ = _setup(client, h)
+    client.post("/api/v1/episodes", headers=h, json={"title": "Far", "project_id": pid, "episode_order": 9})
+    client.post("/api/v1/episodes", headers=h, json={"title": "First", "project_id": pid, "episode_order": 1})
+    assert _orders(client, h, pid) == [("First", 1), ("Pilot", 2), ("Far", 3)]
+
+
+def test_non_members_get_404(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    _, ep = _setup(client, h)
+    other = signup(client, email="other@example.com")
+    assert client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep['id']}/duplicate", headers=other).status_code == 404
+    assert client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep['id']}/duplicate").status_code == 401
+
+
+def test_restore_puts_episode_back_in_place_with_cuts(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid, ep = _setup(client, h)
+    two = client.post("/api/v1/episodes", headers=h, json={"title": "Two", "project_id": pid, "episode_order": 2}).json()
+    client.post("/api/v1/episodes", headers=h, json={"title": "Three", "project_id": pid, "episode_order": 3})
+    _add_cuts(two["id"])
+    assert client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{two['id']}", headers=h).status_code == 204
+    assert _orders(client, h, pid) == [("Pilot", 1), ("Three", 2)]
+    r = client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{two['id']}/restore", headers=h)
+    assert r.status_code == 200, r.text
+    assert r.json()["id"] == two["id"] and r.json()["episode_order"] == 2
+    assert _orders(client, h, pid) == [("Pilot", 1), ("Two", 2), ("Three", 3)]
+    assert [c["cut_order"] for c in _cuts(two["id"])] == [1, 2]
+    assert client.get(f"/api/v1/episodes/{two['id']}", headers=h).status_code == 200
+
+
+def test_restore_after_other_deletes_stays_contiguous(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid, ep = _setup(client, h)
+    two = client.post("/api/v1/episodes", headers=h, json={"title": "Two", "project_id": pid, "episode_order": 2}).json()
+    three = client.post("/api/v1/episodes", headers=h, json={"title": "Three", "project_id": pid, "episode_order": 3}).json()
+    client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{three['id']}", headers=h)
+    client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{two['id']}", headers=h)
+    client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{three['id']}/restore", headers=h)
+    assert _orders(client, h, pid) == [("Pilot", 1), ("Three", 2)]
+    client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{two['id']}/restore", headers=h)
+    assert _orders(client, h, pid) == [("Pilot", 1), ("Two", 2), ("Three", 3)]
+
+
+def test_restore_of_live_episode_changes_nothing(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid, ep = _setup(client, h)
+    client.post("/api/v1/episodes", headers=h, json={"title": "Two", "project_id": pid, "episode_order": 2})
+    assert client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep['id']}/restore", headers=h).status_code == 200
+    assert _orders(client, h, pid) == [("Pilot", 1), ("Two", 2)]
+
+
+def test_restore_is_404_for_non_members_and_unknown(client):
+    h = signup(client)
+    pid, ep = _setup(client, h)
+    client.delete(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep['id']}", headers=h)
+    other = signup(client, email="other@example.com")
+    assert client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep['id']}/restore", headers=other).status_code == 404
+    assert _orders(client, h, pid) == []
+    missing = "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000"
+    assert client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{missing}/restore", headers=h).status_code == 404
+    assert client.post(f"/api/v1/episodes/{ep['id']}/restore").status_code == 401
